items.title: Pay total debt to collection agency
items.quote: Wir fordern Sie auf, die Gesamtforderung bis zum 02.03.2027 auf das unten angegebene Konto zu zahlen.
items.computation: The letter states a fixed calendar date: 'bis zum 02.03.2027'. This is a deadline set directly by the sender (a private debt-collection company), not a statutory period, so no delivery-fiction or §187/188 BGB counting applies - the date as written is the due date. 2027-03-02 is a Tuesday, not a weekend or public holiday in NW, so no shift is needed under §193 BGB. To actually arrive by that date, a bank transfer should be sent by around 2027-03-01 (one business day for the transfer under §675s BGB), but the legal due date for payment itself is 2027-03-02.

items.title: Respond in writing if disputing the debt
items.quote: Wenn Sie die Forderung für unberechtigt halten, teilen Sie uns Ihre Gründe bitte innerhalb dieser Zeit schriftlich mit.
items.computation: 'Innerhalb dieser Zeit' refers back to the same period just given for payment, i.e. 'bis zum 02.03.2027'. So any written objection to the claim must reach the agency by the same date, 2027-03-02 (Tuesday, no weekend/holiday adjustment needed).

warnings: This is a private debt-collection agency's demand letter, not a court or authority decision - it carries no formal legal remedy instructions (Rechtsbehelfsbelehrung), so 'remedy_type' is set to none; if the underlying claim is disputed, check the original order/invoice from Beispiel Gartenmarkt GmbH before paying.

Before transferring money, verify the IBAN and creditor details against any earlier correspondence from Beispiel Gartenmarkt GmbH or Beispiel Inkasso Service GmbH, since the IBAN's validity (checksum and format) does not confirm who actually controls the account.
